title: Citation
description: Machine-readable provenance for one clinical claim or extracted field. Every clinical claim the agent shows carries one. source_type=document citations are anchored (anchored=true, bbox present) only when deterministic code found the value on the page at row level; anchored=false means the model proposed a value the anchor step could not place, and the panel renders it as unverified. chart and guideline citations are always anchored=true with no bbox (the quote is the anchor).

source_type.description: chart: an OpenEMR row (Week 1 fact). document: an uploaded lab PDF or intake form. guideline: a chunk of the guideline corpus.

source_id.description: chart: <service>#<record_id>. document: the OpenEMR documents.id. guideline: the manifest source id.

page_or_section.description: document: page number as a string. guideline: heading path of the chunk. chart: the field name.

field_or_chunk_id.description: document: JSON pointer of the extracted field (e.g. /results/3/value). guideline: chunk id sha256(source_id|section|ordinal)[:12]. chart: the fact id.

quote_or_value.description: The verbatim text this citation points at.

oneOf.description: Where on the source page a value was anchored. Coordinates are PDF points with a top-left origin, regardless of whether the page had a text layer (PyMuPDF words) or was OCRed (tesseract word boxes converted from pixels using the rasterization scale).

page_w.description: Page width in points, so a viewer can scale the box to any render size.

bbox.description: Where on the source page a value was anchored. Coordinates are PDF points with a top-left origin, regardless of whether the page had a text layer (PyMuPDF words) or was OCRed (tesseract word boxes converted from pixels using the rasterization scale).

oneOf.description: The whole table row that supports a document value (analyte, value, unit together), for the viewer to outline.

page_w.description: Page width in points, so a viewer can scale the box to any render size.

row_bbox.description: The whole table row that supports a document value (analyte, value, unit together), for the viewer to outline.
